model.unknowns: every row's 256 message words and 256 pads per role; M's prefixes, pads, b, u
model.observations: full group and proximity vectors (message and pad coordinates), terminals, H's zero-sum, the 256 opened columns of every row; M's q', proximity, fourteen functionals and 256 columns of 20 base rows
model.reduction: per role, ker E_J spanned by [I; -G E^m] and [0; V_J X^i] on the captured J; fold observations decouple per coordinate; terminals keep O8's weights
